title: 47:14 stubble. Farmers burn their land to clear and cleanse it. The Lord will do the same at the end of the world. After he has harvested the wheat (the righteous), he will burn the remainder (the chaff, or the wicked) with the fire of his coming (33:11- 12; Mal. 4:1; 1 Ne. 22:15; 2 Ne. 26:4-6; D&C 64:24).
author: Tina M. Peterson
